members.description: The form field name. Radios in one group share it.

declarations.name: Field
declarations.summary: A labeled text control: one line by default, several with `multiline`.
declarations.description: Rendered by src/components/ui/Field.astro. Not a custom element: it keeps the native element that carries the role and writes sdc- classes on it, styled in src/layouts/Site.astro. Import the component rather than writing the markup by hand.

members.name: id
members.description: Ties the label to the control. Required, because a field without it has no name.

members.name: label
members.description: The visible label, and the accessible name.

members.name: name
members.description: The form field name, when the value is submitted.

members.name: value
members.description: The starting text.

members.name: multiline
members.description: A textarea instead of a single line.

members.name: rows
members.description: Visible lines when multiline.

members.name: maxLength
members.description: The most characters the field accepts. Say the limit in the hint too.

members.name: type
members.description: The input type for a single line: text, email, search, url or tel.

members.name: hint
members.description: One line of help under the control.

members.name: error
members.description: The validation message. Present means the field is invalid.

members.name: required
members.description: Marks the control required and puts an asterisk in the label.

members.name: autocomplete
members.description: The browser autofill hint, such as "name" or "email". Worth setting on anything a person has typed before.

members.name: inputmode
members.description: The on-screen keyboard to offer, such as "email" or "tel".

members.name: disabled
members.description: Greys the control out and stops it submitting.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Shown in an empty control. Never the only label.

declarations.name: Fieldset

declarations.description: Rendered by src/components/ui/Fieldset.astro. Not a custom element: it keeps the native element that carries the role and writes sdc- classes on it, styled in src/layouts/Site.astro. Import the component rather than writing the markup by hand.

members.name: legend
members.description: The group's name, rendered as the legend.

members.name: desc
members.description: One line under the legend explaining the group. Tied to the fieldset with aria-describedby.

members.name: id
members.description: Ties the description to the fieldset. Only needed when desc is set.

members.name: id
members.description: Ties a form's script to this region.

members.name: message

members.name: tone
members.description: Tints the message. Colour is never the only signal: the words carry it.

members.description: Ties a form's script to this region.

members.name: lede
members.description: The sentence above the list.

members.name: tone
members.description: Which status colour to wear. Error is a failed submit, warning is saved with something to check, success is done.
